name: Min-Max Octree Rendering
aliases: Unclassified Volume Rendering with Min-Max Octree
definition: A rendering algorithm useful when classification is adjusted frequently. It relies on a min-max octree containing the minimum and maximum values of each voxel field, computed once when a new volume is acquired.
summary: Min-Max Octree Rendering accelerates unclassified volume ray-casting by storing raw data in a hierarchical min-max structure to skip irrelevant regions, avoiding costly classification table recomputation when transfer functions change frequently.
